dct_description_sm: 'READ ME - File and data information.xlsx' contains a short description of the files and data included in this dataset.

Data from radio frequency identification (RFID) tracers deployed in the San Juan River, British Columbia, Canada from September 2015 to August 2019 and in-channel topographic changes during this period.

RFID tracer data: shapefiles of tracer recovery locations (including attribute information), burial depths histograms, path length distributions (raw and scaled), path length and relative mobility as a function of grain size, total excess stream power relations, and mean scaled travel distances as a function of dimensionless peak stream power.

Topographic change data: DEMs of difference (DoDs) from 2015 to 2018, and 2018 to 2019. Plots of tracer burial depth as a function of net elevation change in DoD.
dct_title_s: Data for: Bed particle displacements and morphological development in a wandering gravel-bed river
